newsitem.title: DUBAI: Technical problem shuts Saudi methanol plant-SABIC.
newsitem.headline: Technical problem shuts Saudi methanol plant-SABIC.

text.p: A technical problem shut down Saudi Methanol Co's (Ar-Razi) 700,000 tonne per year methanol plant on May 9 and the plant will re-open on May 17, a spokesman for the Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) said on Wednesday.
"There has been a minor technical problem in Ar-Razi 2, which was shut down on Friday and will be operational on this coming Saturday," Saad al-Youssef told Reuters.

Ar-Razi, which operates the world's biggest methanol complex with an annual capacity of 1.4 million tonnes, is a 50-50 joint venture between SABIC and a consortium of Japanese companies led by Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Co.
The spokesman did not say what the technical problem was.
